sources.exact_text:
On-demand Trip - Rider Cancellation & Waiting Time Policy Statement
All cancellations made within 3 minutes of matching are not chargeable.
Rider will be charged a Cancellation Fee of $6.61* if:
Rider cancels after 3 minutes of matching OR
The driver presses “I’m Here”, waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to arrive at the pick-up point and cancels the trip (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion)
Riders are guaranteed 3 minutes of grace period from the time of match and/or 15 minutes before scheduled time for Advance Trip Request before the Cancellation Fee kicks in.

Drivers are only allowed to indicate arrival and impose the Waiting Time Fee only if he/she:
Is at the pick-up location according to GPS data
AND
Has waited for more than 3 mins
Otherwise, you will not be charged the $6.61 Waiting Time Fee if any of the above are not fulfilled.
Nonetheless, do reach out to us if you feel you have been charged unfairly or wrongly, and we’ll be happy to assist you.

conditions: Driver presses arrival, waits more than 3 minutes at pickup, rider does not arrive, driver cancels, no trip completion.
Rider matching grace remains relevant. Principal rider policy states SGD 6.61 cancellation fee.
exceptions_and_limits: An arrival button press alone does not prove location.
No-show and completed-trip waiting are different events.
GPS wording comes from waiting-fee FAQ; applying its validity safeguard to no-show is a proposed interpretation.
unresolved_questions: Arrival tolerance and exception handling need policy-owner confirmation.

Advanced Trip - Rider Cancellation & Waiting Time Policy Statement
All cancellations made > 15 minutes before the scheduled trip time are not chargeable.
(eg: Scheduled trip: 6 PM, any cancellation made before 5:45 PM is not chargeable.
If the advanced trip request is accepted only after 5:45 PM, riders will have a 3 minute grace period)
Rider will be charged a Cancellation Fee of $6.61* if:
Rider cancels after the cancellation window (< Scheduled - 15mins OR Matched) OR
The driver cancels the trip after waiting for > 3 minutes for the Rider to arrive at the pick-up point (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion)
Riders may be charged a Waiting Time Fee of $5 at the end of the trip if:
The driver waits for > 3 minutes for the Rider to board and continues to complete the trip (Rider boards and driver completes trip)
Riders are guaranteed 3 minutes of grace period from the time of match and/or 15 minutes before scheduled time for Advance Trip Request before the Cancellation Fee kicks in.

conditions: Cancellation more than 15 minutes before schedule is free.
Late acceptance example grants 3-minute matching grace.
No-show waiting and completed-trip waiting are distinct; both use more-than-3-minute wording.
exceptions_and_limits: Source algebra is ambiguous; do not execute it literally.
Do not start early-arrival no-show clock without clarification.

sources.exact_text:
We are excited to announce the full rollout of a new feature that allows you to update your trip destination during a ride. Please note the following guidelines:
Inform Your Driver First – Before changing your destination, kindly notify your driver. If the new destination significantly increases the trip’s distance or duration, the driver may not be able to accommodate the change.
Driver Acceptance – After updating your destination in the app, please let your driver know. They will have a limited time to accept the change. If they do not respond within this period, your request will be automatically declined.
Fare Adjustment – Once the driver accepts, your trip fare will be recalculated, and your route will be updated to the new destination.
*RydePOOL, RydeTAXI & Multiple stop bookings are not allowed to make any changes in destination.
Effective 17 Oct 2025

The driver receives an edit request pop-up.
The driver can accept or reject the request.
If the driver accepts, they receive a notification, and the add/edit destination fee is reflected on their receipt.
If the driver rejects, the previous trip details remain, and no fee is reflected on their receipt.

conditions: Inform driver and submit edit in app.
Driver acceptance required; nonresponse causes decline.
Acceptance recalculates fare and updates route.
exceptions_and_limits: Rejection preserves previous trip details.
Do not treat a chat request alone as an accepted app edit.
Existing multistop exclusion is explicit.
unresolved_questions: Acceptance timeout duration not stated here; do not import pilot timing.

sources.exact_text:
On-Demand Trip
A Cancellation Fee compensates drivers for the time and effort they spend getting to the rider’s location.
A Waiting Time Fee allows our drivers to be compensated by riders for the time spent waiting at a pickup location.
All cancellations made within 3 minutes of matching are not chargeable.
Driver will receive a Cancellation Fee of $4.50* if:
Rider cancels after 3 minutes of matching
Driver may charge a Waiting Time Fee of $4.50 at the end of the trip if:
The driver pressed “I’m Here”, waits for > 3 minutes for rider to arrive at pick-up point and  cancels the trip (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion), OR
The driver pressed “I’m Here”, waits for > 3 minutes for rider to board, and continues the trip  (Rider boards and driver completes trip).

Please let us know why you are cancelling.
Drivers will receive a $4.50 cancellation fee automatically if they cancel after >3 minutes of waiting.

Rider will be charged a Cancellation Fee of $6.61* if:
Rider cancels after 3 minutes of matching OR
The driver presses “I’m Here”, waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to arrive at the pick-up point and cancels the trip (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion)
Riders may be charged a Waiting Time Fee of $5 at the end of the trip if:
The driver presses “I’m Here”, waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to board, and continues the trip (Rider boards and driver completes trip).

conditions: Driver-facing policy names SGD 4.50 compensation; rider-facing policy uses other gross amounts.
exceptions_and_limits: Different payee amounts need not be contradictory.
No-show naming and completed waiting amounts remain inconsistent.

sources.exact_text:
Advanced Trip - Rider Cancellation & Waiting Time Policy Statement
All cancellations made > 15 minutes before the scheduled trip time are not chargeable.
(eg: Scheduled trip: 6 PM, any cancellation made before 5:45 PM is not chargeable.
If the advanced trip request is accepted only after 5:45 PM, riders will have a 3 minute grace period)
Rider will be charged a Cancellation Fee of $6.61* if:
Rider cancels after the cancellation window (< Scheduled - 15mins OR Matched) OR
The driver cancels the trip after waiting for > 3 minutes for the Rider to arrive at the pick-up point (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion)
Riders may be charged a Waiting Time Fee of $5 at the end of the trip if:
The driver waits for > 3 minutes for the Rider to board and continues to complete the trip (Rider boards and driver completes trip)
Riders are guaranteed 3 minutes of grace period from the time of match and/or 15 minutes before scheduled time for Advance Trip Request before the Cancellation Fee kicks in.

conflicts.title: Refund versus waiver mechanism
conflicts.description: General nonrefund language, discretionary refund and specific voucher waiver require separate scopes.
conflicts.handling_proposed: Not necessarily contradiction; require named procedure and authorized remedy.

sources.exact_text: Users are required to make full payment of the User Charges for all services offered in the Application by the method selected at the time of booking, which may be cash, or one of the automated payment methods available to you on the Application. Any payment pursuant to such selection is non-refundable and irrevocable.

Unless otherwise stated in any Ryde Policy, you may cancel your request for transportation and delivery services at any time before you commence your ride with the Partner that has been matched with you by the Service.
If you decide to cancel your ride booking or do not show up at the designated location, you may be charged a Cancellation Fee or such other Cancellation Fee as Ryde may notify from time to time via the Cancellation and Waiting Time Policy on Ryde’s website.
If you feel you were incorrectly charged a Cancellation Fee, you may contact Ryde in writing at support@rydesharing.com for assistance. Ryde reserves its absolute discretion to any refunds to you and such refunds may be credited to the payment card you used for the journey, or to your RydeCoins wallet or by such other method as is deemed reasonable by Ryde.

If you feel that you have been unfairly charged a Cancellation Fee, you may submit a fee waiver request via RydeHELP in our app within 30 days of the trip* and we will review your eligibility for a refund.
If you are eligible, we will issue you a voucher** with a unique code worth $6.61 as a refund for the incurred Cancellation Charges. Please be mindful to top up your Ryde wallet using the voucher code given to you within the expiry period.
*Requests submitted after 30 days of the trip will not be considered for waivers.
**This voucher is non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash in part or in full. There is strictly no extension of the expiry date from the date of issue.
The increase is due to the platform fee changes effective 17 Feb 2026.
